description: Combined human vs LLM adjudication sheet for permissions_eval label_sheet_v1. Only pages with both human labels and llm_labels complete are included. For each page, adjudicated_labels is pre-filled from agreement: when both agree on a field, that value is copied; when they disagree, the field is null and must be filled by a human adjudicator. Do not mutate label_sheet_v1.json for adjudication — edit adjudicated_labels here (or the companion .md).
